findings.headline: Migrate this Context.Provider JSX site to direct context provider syntax.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 removes the Context.Provider pattern (createContext now returns the provider component itself, and .Provider is undefined); use the context value directly as a JSX component: <ThemeContext value={...}>.
findings.guidance: Replace <ThemeContext.Provider value={...}> with <ThemeContext value={...}>. Remove the .Provider suffix — the context itself is now the provider component. The value prop and children remain unchanged, but confirm the value is never undefined: Solid 2 treats value={undefined} as no provider, so a default-less context then throws ContextNotFoundError instead of falling back as 1.x did; use null as an explicit empty value.
